children: Arab Otsuka Nutraceuticals has launched a locally manufactured ORONAMIN C drink in Egypt, marking a new step in the brand’s regional and global expansion strategy, according to a press release.
The product is manufactured at the company’s advanced facility in the El Robbiki Industrial Zone, 10 of Ramadan City, spanning around 95,000 square meters.
Launched in the Gulf region in 1985, ORONAMIN C DRINK has become a widely consumed nutritional drink across GCC markets. The product was introduced to the Egyptian market in early 2024.

Egypt was selected as the company’s central manufacturing and export hub for ORONAMIN C DRINK, leveraging its manufacturing infrastructure, skilled workforce, and strategic location connecting African and Middle Eastern markets.

Starting in 2026, locally manufactured ORONAMIN C is set to be exported from Egypt to the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, and Kuwait, strengthening the country’s role as a regional production and distribution center.
